items.description: Saudi Aramco has cut prices for its benchmark oil grade to Asia to a six-year low as Persian Gulf producers race for market share with flows through the Strait of Hormuz increasing.

items.title: Indian Bond Yield Curve Seen Flatter as RBI Drains Surplus Cash
items.description: India’s bond curve is poised to flatten further as the Reserve Bank of India steps up liquidity withdrawals, prompting some investors to favor 10-year debt over five-year notes.

items.title: Nippon Paint to Buy Akzo’s Southeast Asia Unit for $1.35 Billion
items.description: Nippon Paint Holdings Co. is buying Akzo Nobel NV’s decorative paints operations in Southeast Asia for $1.35 billion, acquiring a regional slice of a business it had sought to buy in full.

items.title: Gold Edges Higher as Markets Weigh Jobs Data Impact on Fed Path
items.description: Gold edged up after its biggest weekly drop since June, as traders weighed the impact of a slowdown in the US jobs market and higher bond yields on the Federal Reserve’s path for interest rates.

items.title: China Fund Closures Head for Eight-Year High as Demand Fades
items.description: China’s mutual funds are closing at the fastest pace in eight years as weak returns and investor redemptions leave hundreds of products too small to survive.

items.title: Asian Shares Rise as Fed Bets Ease, Bonds Edge Up: Markets Wrap
items.description: Asian stocks rose after softer US jobs data reduced pressure on the Federal Reserve to keep raising interest rates. Oil erased early gains, while bonds crept higher.

items.title: Schneider Said to Near Deal to Buy PTC for More Than $20 Billion
